top_choice_rationale: Base editing for Liu alone is a single, explainable achievement whose new chemistry (a nucleobase deaminase on a programmable binder and an evolved TadA acting on DNA) is distinct from the 2020 double-strand-cleavage prize. It has been reproduced independently for about ten years and has reached patients, and Liu is the least disputed attribution. Targeted protein degradation ranks next as a game-changer in waiting, but no degrader is approved and the three-from-eight attribution is unsettled. Two-part packages with unrelated science read as a trade.
